endpoint_contract.raw_measurement: Published observed joint-library log2(RNA/DNA) activities, with documented three independent infections/replicates percell from the shared source library; preserve individual replicate and published mean/median-normalized aggregate values exactly as supplied.
endpoint_contract.units: Raw/replicate activity in documented log2RNA/DNA units, with source median-normalization annotation; sourceESS dimensionless; counts/barcodes distinct units and not independent experiments.
endpoint_contract.required_roles: Unambiguous empirical activity roles from officialcaption/methods+schema: exact stableelementID, cellcontext, replicate identifier/three-replicate aggregate, and scoreunits. PublishedESS can additionally be bound separately. Sourcepredictions, performance, activitybins and inferred rawvalues fromESS are never empirical rawlabels.
endpoint_contract.source_methods: Published methods describe perreplicate median normalization, then arithmeticmean overthree independent infections. They describe percell zscore ofjointactivity, followedby subtracting each element acrosscell mean. They do not specify reconstructedSDddof or an extra ESScolumnstandardization. Record code/version history separately.
endpoint_contract.no_replacement: Freeze all original empirical cellvalues/rawlexemes/NA tokens unchanged. Derived arithmetic arrays below are diagnostic only and never overwrite sourcevalues, oldS9, oldpanel, oldfits or frozenprimarylosses.
endpoint_contract.missing_fields: Mark absent replicate/aggregate/ESS/count/DNA fields as nonestimable for the affected checks. Do not infer unavailable rawactivities, pseudocounts, counts, normalization constants or replicates from ESS/predictions.
endpoint_contract.replicate_independence: Three infections are withinone source study/library, not three independent studies. Barcodecounts/molecules/source rowcopies are not replicate experimentalunits.
